headline: Key Fronts See Base Turnover, Rising Casualties
war_summary: Three hours on the map show the bloodiest sectors easing their base turnover while the butcher’s bill climbs. Weathered Expanse, still the deadliest theatre, has slipped to forty‑three ownership changes in the last day from fifty, yet colonial and Warden dead each rose by roughly eight hundred in the past two hours. Linn Mercy added three more flips to reach forty, its two‑hour toll now ninety‑three colonial and two‑hundred‑forty‑three Warden casualties. Nevish Line holds at forty‑five exchanges, both sides shedding about a thousand men in the latest two‑hour window. Mooring County’s activity has risen to fifteen flips, with modest losses of forty‑nine colonial and thirty‑four Warden. Stonecradle remains at fourteen flips, but its two‑hour casualties have climbed to eighty‑three colonial and one‑hundred‑two Warden. Callahans Passage, previously static, recorded six flips in the day and heavy losses of eighteen hundred colonial and fourteen hundred Warden in the last two hours. Dead Lands and Marban Hollow have gone quiet, reporting only light casualties. Enlistments continue a modest rise across the active zones, feeding fresh manpower into the grinder.
